about.description:
Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before
they reach the LLM — 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. It ships as a
Python library (SmartCrusher, ContentRouter, CodeCompressor, CCR,
TOIN compressors with a Rust core), a transparent proxy, and an MCP
server.

This package provides the core library and CLI. Upstream optional
extras (proxy server, MCP, tree-sitter code compression, ML/Kompress,
memory/vector stacks, OCR, LangChain/Agno integrations) are not
included; install their dependencies separately as needed.
about.summary: The Context Optimization Layer for LLM Applications - Cut costs by 50-90%

raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.37.0"

package:
  name: headroom-ai
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/h/headroom-ai/headroom_ai-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 7ffdecba91ce44dd02f1601499f6c935c47374b7cb6ec61e569b816a4bb78a26

build:
  number: 1
  skip:
    # litellm pulls the compiled fastuuid, which ships py311+ on macOS while
    # linux gets py310 too. 
    - osx and match(python, "<3.11")
  script:
    # tree-sitter's unicode.h needs le16toh/be16toh from <endian.h>, which the
    # cos7 sysroot (glibc 2.17) only exposes under _BSD_SOURCE. Our default
    # CFLAGS set _POSIX_C_SOURCE + _DEFAULT_SOURCE, but this glibc predates
    # _DEFAULT_SOURCE, so _BSD_SOURCE never gets auto-enabled. _GNU_SOURCE
    # forces it on. Only required for linux
    - if: linux
      then:
        - export CFLAGS="${CFLAGS} -D_GNU_SOURCE"
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  python:
    entry_points:
      - headroom = headroom.cli:main

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - python
    - maturin >=1.5,<2.0
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    - tiktoken >=0.5.0
    - pydantic >=2.0.0
    - if: match(python, "<3.14")
      then:
        - litellm >=1.86.2,<2.0
    - click >=8.3.3
    - rich >=13.0.0
    - opentelemetry-api >=1.24.0
    - ast-grep >=0.30.0,!=0.44.1
    - pyyaml >=6.0
    - tomlkit >=0.13.0,<1.0
    - fastapi
    - if: match(python, "<3.11")
      then:
        - tomli >=2.0.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - headroom
        - headroom._core
      # ast-grep-cli is satisfied by the conda ast-grep binary package,
      # which leaves no ast-grep-cli dist-info -> pip check cannot pass.
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - headroom --help

about:
  summary: The Context Optimization Layer for LLM Applications - Cut costs by 50-90%
  description: |
    Headroom compresses tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before
    they reach the LLM — 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. It ships as a
    Python library (SmartCrusher, ContentRouter, CodeCompressor, CCR,
    TOIN compressors with a Rust core), a transparent proxy, and an MCP
    server.

    This package provides the core library and CLI. Upstream optional
    extras (proxy server, MCP, tree-sitter code compression, ML/Kompress,
    memory/vector stacks, OCR, LangChain/Agno integrations) are not
    included; install their dependencies separately as needed.
  homepage: https://headroom-docs.vercel.app
  repository: https://github.com/headroomlabs-ai/headroom
  documentation: https://headroom-docs.vercel.app/docs
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - soapy1
    - rxm7706
